annotation.bound_parties_text: The resolution calls on and urges State Parties to the African Charter (and calls on the African Union and regional bodies) to ensure rights-compatible AI and robotics governance; it is a non-binding resolution.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Calls on State Parties to ensure that the development and use of AI, robotics and other new and emerging technologies is compatible with the rights and duties in the African Charter
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Resolution on the need to undertake a Study on human and peoples’ rights and artificial intelligence (AI), robotics and other new and emerging technologies in Africa
